class.name: GodotDoctorDock
class.brief_description: A dock for GodotDoctor that displays validation warnings. Warnings can be related to nodes or resources. Clicking on a warning will select the node in the scene tree or open the resource in the inspector. Used by [GodotDoctorEditorValidationReporter] to show validation warnings.

method.name: _enter_tree
method.description: Connects the validate-now button signal when the dock enters the scene tree.

method.name: _exit_tree
method.description: Disconnects the validate-now button signal when the dock exits the scene tree.

method.name: _on_validate_now_button_pressed
method.description: Triggers validation of the current scene root and edited resource when the button is pressed.

method.name: add_node_validation_message
method.description: Adds a node-related message to the dock for [param origin_node]. Displays [param validation_message] with the appropriate severity icon. Clicking the entry selects [param origin_node] in the scene tree.

method.name: add_resource_validation_message
method.description: Adds a resource-related message to the dock for [param origin_resource]. Displays [param validation_message] with the appropriate severity icon. Clicking the entry opens [param origin_resource] in the inspector.

method.name: clear_errors
method.description: Removes all warnings from the dock.

method.name: _mark_title_dirty
method.description: Updates the dock title on next idle frame to indicate the current number of messages. Does nothing if the title is already marked dirty to avoid redundant updates.

method.name: _update_title
method.description: Updates the dock title to include the current number of messages.

method.name: _get_warning_icon_path_for_severity
method.description: Returns the icon asset path corresponding to [param severity_level].
